title: EU Climate & Energy Daily Briefing
subtitle: Saturday, 17 October 2026 — Key developments from the last 24 hours

highlights.headline: Russia wants blackout in Ukraine as winter comes — Zelenskyy
highlights.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy says Russia is trying to cut electricity and heating to civilians ahead of winter. He also called the US president's waiver of new sanctions on Moscow a boost for Vladimir Putin.

highlights.headline: 65th Plenary Session of IPCC suspended
highlights.summary: ADDIS ABABA, Oct 16 – The IPCC Chair, Jim Skea, suspended tonight the 65th Plenary Session in Addis Ababa after the meeting ran over its planned duration and many delegations from least developed countries and Small Island Developing States had to leave. items.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
items.description: The Amazon rainforest is a crucial buffer against climate change - but deforestation had expanded under former president Jair Bolsonaro.

items.title: Fast-moving California wildfire burns homes as people are ordered to leave
items.description: Fanned by the fierce Santa Ana winds, the Norte Fire is one of 13 burning across the state.

items.title: Brazil: Amazon deforestation lowest in nearly 40 years
items.description: The latest figures show that 3,335 square kilometers of the Amazon rainforest were cleared in the year ending in July, the lowest level since 1988. The drop has been described as an "historic achievement."
